gloss.en: The term "كاسف البال" (kāsif al-bāl) is defined by referring to the entry for "بال" (bāl). This suggests that its meaning is closely tied to or explained within the definition of "bāl" itself.
gloss.short: The term "كاسف البال" (kāsif al-bāl) is defined by referring to the entry for "بال" (bāl).
